brief: public CharSequence pad(final boolean addIndent, final CharSequence text){}
method_comment:
* Pads a string to the maximum width or optionally to the maximum width - indent. *
    *
  • Returns the string unchanged if it is longer than the specified length.
    • *
  • Will add the padding based on the alignment.
    • *
* * @param addIndent if {@code true} account for the indent when padding the string. * @param text the text to pad. * @return the padded string.
